capabilities: Create and edit BananaMark papers in Source mode
Preview equations, theorem blocks, TikZ diagrams and references
Manage chapters, paper details and a shared YAML bibliography
Import and compare papers from Peerpedia
Publish papers to Peerpedia with an access token
disambiguation: Not a wiki or encyclopedia; it is an offline BananaMark paper authoring and preview tool that optionally imports from and submits to the Peerpedia site.
extras: Apple silicon Macs only; no client-side telemetry; tokens in Obsidian secret storage; renderer, fonts and diagram engine bundled for offline use; large files may exceed Obsidian Sync Standard per-file limit; no payment required.
problem: Obsidian's reading mode does not render BananaMark syntax, so researchers lack an offline paper-writing workflow with proper preview and Peerpedia publishing.

relations.evidence: Explicit import, comparison and submission contact the Peerpedia site you select.

requires.name: Obsidian Desktop 1.15.1+ on Apple silicon Mac

summary: Offline paper-writing plugin for Apple silicon Macs with BananaMark completion, preview, shared bibliography, and Peerpedia import, compare and publish.
